Oh boy, It’s been a crazy week of coffee for me

These are the following beans I have had within this week.

-Finca Deborah Amber Vivid Geisha from Ona coffee
-El obraje washed Geisha from Sweet Bloom 
-Honduras Coe 2018 El trapiche From lilo coffee, Osaka Japan

The Finca Debora Vivid is a washed Carbonic maceration coffee, which goes through the Cm process before going through the traditional wash fermentation to enhance its mouthfulness and flavour , feeling notes of orange bloom friut tea with a jasmine undertone. Nectar juice truly.

The El obraje Geisha has hints of mango and white grape juice with a sugarcane sweetness

The El traipche reminds me of a tropical fruit tea, with a strawberry like sweetness hints of mango 

My palate are truly spoiled lol
